text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: May I ask what you thought of my<n>running today?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the most part, she was as<n>confident as ever on
the track...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But now that I think about it, she<n>might have looked
a little tired.
choice_data_list: You seemed to be struggling a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So you thought the same... Perhaps I<n>should start
paying more attention to<n>my body's needs and give
myself<n>some rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not that you're at fault, of course.<n>We've both been
pushing ourselves<n>a little too hard of late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We must both strive to keep one<n>another at the top
of our game.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has a point. It might be<n>wise to
rethink our schedule.
